text: Maya, a tollbooth worker in Jakarta, survives a night attack by a man with a golok who calls her Rahayu. An old photograph of her as a child outside a large house leads her and her best friend Dini to the remote village of Harjosari, [hoping to sell an inheritance|trigger|need and greed]. The villagers are cold, children are buried every day, [babies are born without skin|threat|witchcraft and cursed things], and the curse leads back to [three murdered girls|wrong|human sacrifice] whose skin was [made into shadow puppets|images|dolls, masks and likenesses].
